description: This is a PHP unit test class for the MyLeaveRequestAPI in the OrangeHRM Leave API module. It contains test methods for creating, updating, retrieving all, retrieving one, and handling delete operations for leave requests, using data providers and mock services.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MyLeaveRequestAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system, covering CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create leave request API endpoint using data provider.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update leave request API endpoint with different data sets.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all leave requests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method throws a not implemented exception.
